semantics.clock: Original: all sequential logic is triggered on the positive edge of the clock.
semantics.reset: Original: positive edge triggered asynchronous areset resets to walking left; held reset has priority at clock edges.
semantics.transition: At each rising clock edge without reset: left switches to right if bump_left; right switches to left if bump_right; otherwise holds. Both bumps switch direction.
semantics.outputs: Moore outputs: left => walk_left=1, walk_right=0; right => walk_left=0, walk_right=1. No added latency.
semantics.initialization: No initial direction specified before reset; no declaration initialization or pre-reset value assertion.

numeric.widths: All ports and state encoding are one bit
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, saturation or overflow

verification.oracle: Independent direction variable updated by the original directional obstacle rule at rising clock edges; outputs sampled after NBA settlement
verification.coverage: All four bump combinations in both states, repeated both-bump toggles, held reset, off-clock asynchronous reset, reset release, between-edge output stability
verification.success: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only on completion

specification_ambiguities: Pre-reset initial state is unspecified and is not constrained by the testbench.
The phrase one output (internal) is interpreted as one internal direction state; the explicit interface requires both walk outputs.
